Chapter 715: Chapter 16: Generous Bounty (Please Subscribe)

Twenty years in the Two-dimensional World, but only two to three months have passed in the Main Universe.

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan was exchanging intelligence with Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

In the Two-dimensional World, the powerhouses from various major forces had mostly begun to collaborate.

Even those unique and exceptional beings were no exception.

In the Main Universe, those Eleventh Rank, Sixth Tier special lives were terrifying in strength.

...

But in the Two-dimensional World, Eleventh Rank Peak Lives that hadn’t fully matured might die at the hands of a Ninth or Tenth Rank Life.

The power ceiling in the Two-dimensional World isn’t high, and even Eighth Layer Lives could easily reach it.

Under the same power ceiling, an Eleventh Rank Peak Life, relying on powerful spirit will and skillful insights, might manage to sweep away ten or eight existences of the same level.

But what about a hundred or a thousand? It should be noted that the number of Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who fell into the Two-dimensional World exceeded one hundred million.

Eleventh Rank Lives which have not grown to their limits might indeed suffer setbacks if they are careless.

Of course, given time, an Eleventh Rank Life is destined to surpass those of the Eighth Layer.

An Eleventh Rank Powerhouse, through mastery of power, could rise again even if starting from scratch.

But they need time to grow.

…

Eleventh Rank Peak Powerhouses need time, and Lin Yuan also needed time.

With Against-Heaven’s Understanding, starting from the same point,

Lin Yuan was confident he could reach heights and go further than those Eleventh Rank Peak Lives.

…

“Galaxy Master, as an Evolver of our human civilization, I’ve established a stronghold in the capital of Molan Ancient Country. Are you interested in coming over?”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, asked with a smile.

Although, within the Two-dimensional World, every time the heavenly gate opens, only one person can leave,

within the ranks of human civilization’s Evolvers, there is still much unity before completely clearing out the Different Species’ Strong Ones.

“Molan Ancient Country?” Lin Yuan raised his eyebrows slightly.

In the Two-dimensional World’s Vast Continent, Ancient Countries are behemoths surpassing gathering places and cities.

So far, Lin Yuan knew of only twelve Ancient Countries, each established by a Witch Ancestor and commanding vast territories.

“My current location is too remote, Molan Ancient Country is too far.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, casually finding an excuse to brush it off.

In reality, Lin Yuan simply did not want to gather where there were many people.

As one of the twelve Ancient Countries, the capital of Molan is exceedingly prosperous.

Meaning that it was very likely for other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses to head there.

In that place, encountering powerhouses from the Main Universe was all too likely.

“That’s a pity.” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, sighed, not insisting further.

The Vast Continent in the Two-dimensional World was too expansive and, without the ability to utilize Space Rules to leap, traveling became a huge problem.

Following that.

Lin Yuan continued to chat with Nalan, the Vice Tower Master,

The topics were mainly about cultivation and the whereabouts of certain well-known Different Species’ Strong Ones.

“So far, the Luochuan gathering place where I am located is still very safe. There is no trace of any Different Species’ Strong Ones.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although more than a hundred million Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses had fallen into the Two-dimensional World, they seemed exceedingly rare when dispersed across the entire continent.

While the Luochuan gathering place is a major gathering spot, it’s far less significant than city-level forces, let alone Ancient Country-level forces.

Truly powerful Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses almost always gravitate toward prosperous areas, where resources are plentiful and would greatly enhance their strength.

“Galaxy Master, if you have any questions, feel free to contact me at any time.” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, finally said.

“Surely.” Lin Yuan nodded.

…

Luochuan gathering place.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“External forces are still unreliable…” Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

Over the years, he had been waiting for news of the Supreme Beings, for if the Supreme Beings could refine that ‘White Paper’, they would have the capability to pull him out.

But now it seemed,

that hope wasn’t very strong.

“My greatest advantage compared to those Eleventh Rank Lives is still my understanding.”

Lin Yuan pondered, upon realizing he couldn’t rely on external forces to leave, he began to assess himself.

Eleventh Rank Lives, in terms of thought process speed and mastery of basic power, would surely surpass Lin Yuan.

But understanding? Even with the lofty perspective it provided, Lin Yuan believed his was far superior to those Eleventh Rank Lives.

Yet, such an advantage could not directly translate into combat power,

especially in the early stages of cultivation, following the Two-dimensional World’s cultivation system, which didn’t demand much in terms of understanding.

The five realms—Witch, Witch King, Witch Emperor, Witch Ancestor, follow this Two-dimensional World’s method of cultivation, and it’s feasible just to cultivate step by step.

The real need for understanding comes after reaching the Witch Ancestor Realm.

After the Witch Ancestor Realm, when there’s no path ahead, to continue to enhance one’s strength, one must forge a new path by reliance on one’s self.

At that moment, Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding would reveal a great advantage.

Simply put,

Before reaching Witch Ancestor, Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed couldn’t keep up with those Eleventh Rank Peak Lives.

But beyond Witch Ancestor, Lin Yuan would overwhelm those Eleventh Rank Peak Lives.

That was also why Lin Yuan declined Nalan’s invitation, hiding in the secluded Luochuan gathering place.

As long as he could get through the initial phases of cultivation, those Eleventh Rank Lives should prepare to be crushed by him.

For now, Lin Yuan didn’t want to interact much with those Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

“Twenty years’ time, and I’ve also cultivated to the peak of the Witch Emperor Realm…” Lin Yuan silently thought.

In fact, had he not hidden here, but moved to a more prosperous area to utilize vast resources, Lin Yuan might have already stepped into the Witch Emperor Realm.
